Nothing failed because nothing asked. The palette is fixed (Material Blue 900) and the pre-fix value is pinned as a counterfactual so the gate is proven against the real defect. The one remaining absolute shortfall (`outline`, 1.82 light / 1.81 dark) is carried openly rather than folded in
